BiblicalUsage: Sema'liy is left-sided, and it names the pillar on the left: Solomon set up the right pillar and called it Jachin, and set up the left pillar, and called it Boaz — and the chronicler says the same, one on the right hand and the other on the left.
TheologicalSignificance: Even the left pillar had a name: nothing in God's house is unnamed or unplaced.
